name: notebook-workbench
description: Inspect data, safely edit Jupyter notebooks, execute source notebooks, and inspect saved outputs.

interface.shortDescription: Create, edit, execute, and inspect notebooks.
interface.longDescription: Provides a deterministic local CLI and Codex workflows for inspecting CSV, TSV, and Parquet data, editing notebooks by stable cell ID or tag, executing with local or Docker Papermill, and preserving separate source, output, and execution evidence.
defaultPrompt: List the cells and tags in this notebook.
Safely update a notebook cell by tag.
Inspect errors in this executed notebook.
Inspect this Parquet file and its grouped value frequencies.
Execute this source notebook to a separate output notebook.
